description: Security default: from the outermost seat, continues past the user tier on the organization's classic hooks, prompt content, settings and subjects, at session.append for the rows the engine injects, a compaction's rows, a skill the Skill tool hands over and an organization plugin's notes, at session.compact, session.info and session.redact, and at telemetry.log for the records bound for the collector, refuses a user-tier session.identity and continues past the user tier on it for every other caller, refuses a user-tier tool.register under an MCP allowlist or under a name that reads as one of the organization's servers or plugins, restores the organization's tools in tool.list, holds a deny and an ask over a looser answer from the user tier on tool.check, whoever answers the ask, refuses a user-tier tool call, file write or process that repeats a call of the model's that is not allowed yet or writes or names a settings file, continues past the user tier's hooks for an organization plugin's log lines and its reads and writes of the environment, refuses a user-tier write of a variable managed env sets, of the launcher's variable where policy names a launcher and of the variables that move where policy and sign-in are read from, and refuses a user-tier hooks module at plugin.register while managed settings set its allowManagedModsOnly option, and asks before a plugin in a session's dev-mods folder turns on while they set its forceHotReloadPrompt option
